audit.adaptation_reason: Exact radius13 and central angle134 require chord CD≈23.93, not24. Recomputed this ancillary chord label and converted its source leader to a protocol dimension; retained the source arcBD label5x.
audit.independent_solution: A radius perpendicular to a chord bisects the chord and its minor arc. Thus arc CB=half of arc CD=134/2=67 degrees.
